review_notes: 'I put words in their mouth to speak' is recast as 'I told them what they should say'. Corrected the verb: 'told' renders the idiom שׂים בְּפִי as a whole, so שׂים, בְּ and פֶּה fuse into one unit headed on the verb under rule 40 (as 'it displease'), rather than the verb alone taking 'told' with its partners unrepresented. Everything else stands as accepted.

variant_decisions.evidence: ASV text 'And I sent them forth' renders the ketiv ואוצאה (hiphil of יצא, 'brought/sent out'); the qere וָאֲצַוֶּ֤ה ('I commanded') is what the textual_variant note 'Another reading is, I gave them commandment' relegates to the margin.

ASV 'the Nethinim' transliterates the qere form הַנְּתִינִים֙ (the proper class-name Nethinim); the ketiv הנתונים would be the passive participle 'those given/appointed' and could not yield the transliteration. The verse's textual_variant note concerns the 'sent forth/commanded' unit, not this one.
